events.label: Kalki in the Puranas
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: The Vishnu and Bhagavata Puranas list Kalki as the final avatar, expected at the end of the Kali Yuga. The accounts differ, and no one is shown in the game. It is a story of hope, not a prediction.

events.label: The Night Before the Lamps
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A storm has felled the road in a dark hill region. You guide one frightened family to a shelter. Everyone arrives together.

events.label: The Bridge of Many Hands
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Villagers on both banks are finishing a bridge over rushing water. You relay planks, nails and rope. The staff steadies, and hurry is the danger.

events.label: The Pass Without a Lamp
events.skill: archery and sword mastery, with restraint
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A night pass with loose rock and a stranded traveller on a ledge. A bow sends a line across, and a sword stays in its sheath. Nobody is hurt.

events.label: The Dawn Road
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A frightened gathering waits at a hill gate before first light. Put every tool away and keep each person in the lamplight. Nothing is shown at the gate except an opening road.

events.label: The Wheel Turns
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: In the Puranic cycle a new Satya Yuga follows the Kali Yuga. The game predicts nothing. It only shows the rings turning back to the start.
